summary.scope: Real browser saved input and captureRecord only -> independent supports/fixtures/contact/finite clearance, seeded rotating-circle TIR, and plane-removed surface -> raw and actual DOM integer. Product fixtureObservations and old expected numbers are not inputs.
summary.counting: Repeated captures of the same input across views and groups are included. Each raw/DOM/model-column row is counted separately; this is not a count of independent physical trials. All after-smoke groups are excluded.
